text_block_list.text: Wheeeew!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I... I ran... and danced my heart out!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Thanks... Wobble...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I'm f-fine, just... letting the tension out!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I guess I was a little too wound up. But
can you
blame me?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Everyone really brought the heat!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I could feel them chipping away at my
energy,
one step at a time. The more I
ran, the more
desperate I became.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I held out until my body had nothing
more to
give. After all, I knew that
waiting for me beyond
the finish line
was...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The winning concert! I got my limp body
back into
gear, ready to give back to my
supportive fans
with a performance of...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
"UNLIMITED IMPACT"! A song that calls
for your
entire heart and soul—the real
deal!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
After we finished, some racers couldn't
even
stand. That's dirt racing for you...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: But that's why I like it!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
You put everything on the line, heart
beating so
fast it feels like it's shaking...
everyone practically
crying out to be
heard!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I want more and more people to watch
me on the
dirt track... and the stage I
love so much!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna fill the stands at dirt races
with crowds
like we saw at the Satsuko
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It seems like a passion has ignited within
Smart
Falcon, and her love for racing on
dirt has been
reaffirmed. In which case,
the natural place to go
from here is...
choice_data_list: Let's keep you at the G1 level.

text_block_list.text:
If she continues with high-profile races,
her fan
base will grow in leaps and
bounds. The
competition will be tough,
but she has what it
takes to succeed!
choice_data_list: We'll get you to the top of dirt racing!

text_block_list.text: Right!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If I reach the top... the whole world will
be
watching. I just know it! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'll go down in history as the top Umadol
on dirt! I
can't waaait! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: So, what's my next race going to be?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Similar in distance to the Japan Dirt
Derby, the
JBC Classic doubles as a
chance to compete with
senior-year
racers, the perfect race to showcase
her
talent.
Classic... Mm, I like the sound of that. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll give it a go! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And so, we set our sights on the JBC
Classic.
